import.title: Employee import
import.subtitle: Upload the employee sheet, review exactly what will change, then confirm.
import.uploadNote: Excel (.xlsx). Nothing is saved at this step — you will see a full preview first.
import.previewFailed: The file could not be checked.
import.confirmNote: Applying writes the changes above. Nothing else in the organization is touched.
import.applyFailed: The import could not be applied.
import.rejectedWillBeSkipped: {count} rejected rows will be skipped; the rest of the file still applies.
import.notPermitted: Employee import is available to HR only.
import.rejectedNote: These rows will not be applied. Fix them in the sheet and upload again.
import.warningsNote: These rows will be applied, but something about them deserves a look.
import.updatesNote: Salary changes show as changed without showing the figures.
import.absentTitle: In the system but not in this file
import.absentNote: Nothing happens to these people. A missing row is never treated as someone leaving.

orgSetup.title: Org setup
orgSetup.subtitle: Entities and departments. Imports place people into these — they never create them.
orgSetup.entitiesNote: Rihal is the parent; TP and CL are subsidiaries.
orgSetup.noEntities: No entities yet. Add Rihal, TP and CL to get started.
orgSetup.departmentsNote: The same name may appear under more than one entity — those are different departments.
orgSetup.notPermitted: Org setup is available to the HR Super Admin only.

cycles.title: Performance cycles
cycles.subtitle: One cycle per performance year, with the three touchpoints HR sets deadlines for.
cycles.notPermitted: Performance cycles are managed by HR. Your own deadlines appear on your own screens.
cycles.loadFailed: Could not load the performance cycles.
cycles.empty: No cycles yet. Create the performance year with its three deadlines to get started.
cycles.emptyViewer: No performance cycles have been created yet.
cycles.openConfirmBody: Opening enrolls every active employee as a participant and makes the year live. A cycle cannot go back to draft.
cycles.closeConfirmBody: Closing ends the year. A closed cycle cannot be reopened, and its deadlines can no longer change.
cycles.createNote: Set the year and all three touchpoints together. The cycle starts as a draft, so nothing is live until you open it.
cycles.editNote: The cycle is still a draft, so these dates are not binding on anyone yet.
cycles.extendNote: Moving a deadline on an open cycle is a formal extension. It is recorded in the audit trail with your name on it.
cycles.created: The {year} cycle was created as a draft.
cycles.opened: The {year} cycle is open. {count} participants enrolled.
cycles.statusFailed: Could not change the cycle status.

form.yearHelp: The performance year, for example 2026. Goal setting for it usually happens in December of the year before.
form.graceHelp: Days after the deadline for HR to intervene. Three by default.

validation.dateRequired: Pick a date for this stage.
validation.deadlineBeforeOpens: The deadline cannot be before the day the stage opens.
validation.graceRange: Grace days must be a whole number between 0 and 30.

roles.title: HR roles
roles.subtitle: Who holds HR authority. Roles are additive — a person may hold more than one.
roles.notPermitted: Only an HR Super Admin can grant or revoke HR roles.
roles.loadFailed: Could not load the employee directory.
roles.rolesUnknownNote: The directory does not report existing HR roles yet, so this list starts empty. Saving replaces this person's whole role set — tick every role they should keep.
roles.noEmployees: No employees yet. Import the employee sheet first.
roles.dialogNote: Ticking a box grants the role; unticking revokes it. The whole set is saved at once.

roleHint.HR_SUPER_ADMIN: Everything: configuration, calibration, the master export, and granting these roles.
roleHint.HRBP: Runs the cycle org-wide, but does not configure the organization.
roleHint.EXECUTIVE_VIEWER: Sees the whole organization, read-only, and acts on nothing.

roles.ownSuperAdminNote: You cannot remove your own HR Super Admin role — it is the only role that can grant itself. Ask another Super Admin to do it.
roles.saveFailed: Could not update the HR roles.

goalSetting.title: Goal setting
goalSetting.subtitle: Draft the KPI set for each direct report, then sign it before the stage locks.
goalSetting.notPermitted: Goal setting is drafted by line managers and HR. Your own KPI set is on your home page.
goalSetting.loadFailed: Could not load the goal-setting roster.
goalSetting.noCycles: No performance cycle exists yet. HR opens the year before goal setting can start.
goalSetting.noOpenCycle: No performance cycle is open. Goal setting starts once HR opens the year, and the deadlines HR set will appear here.
goalSetting.empty: Nobody is enrolled under you for this performance year.
goalSetting.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} participants. Search to narrow the list.

stage.title: Goal setting
stage.notConfigured: This cycle has no goal-setting stage yet, so nothing can be drafted or signed on it.
stage.lockedBody: The deadline passed, so drafting and sign-off are closed for this stage. Only HR can reopen it by extending the deadline.
stage.notYetOpenBody: Nothing can be drafted or signed until the stage opens.
stage.graceNote: HR has {days} days of grace after the deadline to intervene.

kpi.title: KPIs for {name}
kpi.subtitleEditable: Six texts per KPI: what is measured, and what each of the five levels looks like.
kpi.subtitleReadOnly: The KPI set as it stands. You can read it, but you are not its owner.
kpi.deleteConfirmBody: The KPI and its five level descriptors go with it, and the weightage total drops by its share.
kpi.empty: No KPIs yet. Add the first one — the set can be signed once the weightages total 100%.
kpi.emptyReadOnly: No KPIs have been drafted for this employee yet.
kpi.exemptTitle: No goal setting for this employee
kpi.exemptBody: C-Level employees skip goal setting entirely, so there is nothing to draft or sign here.
kpi.weightageComplete: The set totals 100% and can be signed.
kpi.weightageOnTrack: A draft may sit at any total while you work. 100% is what sign-off needs.
kpi.signOffBody: Both parties sign to record agreement. A signature is not the lock — HR approval is.
kpi.noRejectNote: There is no reject button. A party who does not agree simply does not sign, and the conversation happens away from this screen.
kpi.alreadySignedToast: That signature was already on file
kpi.approvedBody: Approved {datetime}. The set is locked as the agreed baseline; a change now goes through a mid-year change request.
kpi.blockedTitle: This KPI set cannot be edited right now
kpi.formNote: All six texts are required. The five levels are what the employee will be rated against at year-end.

form.descriptionHelp: One outcome, stated so both of you would agree whether it was met.
form.weightageHelp: This KPI's share of the set, as a percentage with up to two decimals.
form.levelHelp: What performance at this level looks like.

validation.descriptorRequired: Describe what this level looks like.
validation.weightage: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, with at most two decimals.
validation.tooLong: Keep this to 2000 characters or fewer.

home.myTasksSubtitle: Everything waiting on you, whichever role put it there.
home.oversightSubtitle: What you are entitled to see, whether or not you act on it.
home.noEmployeeRecord: This account is not linked to an employee record yet, so it has no performance tasks. HR links the two when the employee data is imported.
home.noOpenCycle: No performance cycle is open. Tasks and deadlines appear here once HR opens the year.
home.empty: Nothing is waiting on you in the {year} cycle.
home.ownSetSign: Read the descriptors and sign to record your agreement.
home.ownSetWaiting: Your manager has not finished drafting your KPIs yet.
home.reportDraft: The weightages do not total 100% yet, so the set cannot be signed.
home.reportDraftEmpty: No KPIs are drafted for this direct report yet.
home.reportSign: The set totals 100%. Sign it to record your agreement.
home.chainBody: You can see everyone below you, however deep, and act on your direct reports only.
home.orgBody: HR sees every participant in the cycle and every deadline behind them.
home.readOnlyBody: You can see the organisation's performance data and act on none of it.
home.directoryBody: The employees you are entitled to see, with their department and manager.
